chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutevakil (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Muawiyah ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever I guarantee four [characteristics] for four houses in Paradise: Whoever spends [in charity] without fearing poverty, is fair to people regarding himself, spreads peace throughout the world, and refrains from argument even if he is right.

key_terms.بِيَاتٍ: Houses (plural of bayt, referring to dwellings in Paradise)

ai.seo_question: What are the four characteristics that guarantee four houses in Paradise according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links specific ethical conduct to the reward of four distinct houses in Paradise, emphasizing that true generosity stems from trust in divine provision rather than fear of poverty. The inclusion of 'avoiding argument even when right' highlights the Shia virtue of *hilm* (forbearance), prioritizing social harmony over intellectual victory, while spreading peace reflects the Imamate's role in unifying the community.
